description: The 24 Game — combine four numbers with + − × ÷ to make 24. Built-in solver guarantees every deal and gives hints.

faqs.a: Yes. Every deal is checked by the built-in solver before it's shown — if the four numbers can't make 24, they're re-dealt automatically.
Fractions are fine and handled exactly (no rounding). For example 5 ÷ 2 = 2.5 is allowed mid-expression.
Tap a number, tap an operator, tap another number — they merge into one card. Undo steps back. Make the last card equal 24.

howto: Tap a number, then an operator (+ − × ÷), then a second number.
The two merge into one card showing the result.
Reduce everything to a single card worth 24 to win.
title: 24 Game
